text: 320 test photos, the slot `sentences-bioclip2-l14` with name_at 0.78 and offer_at 0.67, every photo through `fuse.py` twice: with the original model's vectors and with the vectors `runs/lab/25-device-int8-per-channel/wasm_int8-per-channel.f16.npy on the ci branch (onnxruntime-web 1.30.0, WASM build, run 25 of the laboratory)`. The two vectors of a photo have a mean cosine of 0.9932 (1st percentile 0.9713). Top species right: 94.1% (91.2 to 96.6) with the original vectors and 93.1% (90.0 to 95.6) with these, a paired difference of -0.9 (-2.8 to +0.9) points; first five: 97.2% (95.0 to 98.8) and 98.1% (96.6 to 99.4). Kind of eye right: 98.4% (96.9 to 99.7) and 98.1% (96.6 to 99.4). A species is named for 88.8% (85.0 to 91.9) and 87.5% (83.8 to 90.9) of the photos, and that name is right for 97.9% (96.1 to 99.3) and 98.2% (96.4 to 99.6). The top species is the same for 96.2% (94.1 to 98.1) of the photos; the top probability moves by 0.019 on average, and 12 photos are named under one set of vectors and left unnamed under the other.
